d:
Bihar ke baksar ki pahchan keval aitihasik shahar ke rup men nahin, balki bhagvan shriram ki smritiyon se juri dharmik dharti ke rup men bhi hai. aagami 29 navanbar se 3 disanbar tak chalne vali panchkoshi parikrama men ahirauli, nadanv, bhabhuar, barka nuaanv aur charitravan men shraddhaluon ki bhari aavajahi hogi.
